messages:
Morgan (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Focus: sales pipeline health, GTM priorities, and partner enablement. Keep replies snappy so we can capture actions.
Tara - VP Sales: Pipeline snapshot: coverage ~3.4x, demo->PO ~8%. Two marquee deals moved to contract review. Question: what's the agreed partner revenue split range for co-sell pilots?
Liam (Partnerships): For pilots we usually propose a flexible split: 60/40 to 80/20 depending on partner contribution. Need to finalize with finance/legal guardrails.
Maya (Finance): Finance prefers capped partner credits and a clawback for churn within 90 days. Also need clarity on whether partner invoices customer or we bill and rebate.
Priya (Legal): If partners invoice customers we need a reseller addendum and indemnities. Otherwise we add partner rebate terms to the MSA. I'll draft both templates.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Growth asks for a partner portal or at least a shared dashboard to see trial activation and conversion. Attribution must be clean.
Ana (PM, Product): We can expose a partner dashboard as a lightweight portal (read-only) and add a partner_id to the signup flow. Engineering estimate for the MVP portal + attribution: 2 devs x 12 days + 1 PM + 1 QA x 4 days.
Tara - VP Sales: Also need partner enablement: one-pager, demo recording, and a short certification checklist so partners can hit the ground running. Who owns cert content?
Liam (Partnerships): Partnerships owns the enablement content, but we'll need product help for the demo script and an official demo account. Planning to reuse the AE playbook.
Ana (PM, Product): We'll provide a demo sandbox and a short API key for partner demos. Tag tickets with `partner-enable-q2`.
Maya (Finance): Quick budget note: we can allocate up to $40k for co-marketing with strategic partners. Any spend above that requires centralized approval.
Priya (Legal): For co-branded material, we can commit to a 5-business-day review cycle for standard assets. Anything that needs legal review of data claims may take longer.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Can we get UTM + partner_id + campaign param on partner links so growth can segment trials and MQLs?
Ana (PM, Product): Yes. Add `partner_id` and `utm_campaign=partner_launch` to the schema. I'll add event docs to the ticket.
Tara - VP Sales: One more: partner certification should unlock a partner discount tier and minor co-sell assistance. Need a clear threshold and an ops workflow for credits.
Maya (Finance): Discount threshold proposal: certified partners get up to 10% referral credit; co-sell deals still require AE approval for discounts up to 15%. Anything >15% requires Sales exec + RevOps approval.
Priya (Legal): We'll build a simple partner addendum that references certification levels and discount tiers.
Liam (Partnerships): Pilot asks also include SSO (SAML) and a webhook for usage events weekly. Will Ops/Eng be okay with that cadence?
Ana (PM, Product): Weekly usage webhook is fine for MVP. SAML support needs a spike: estimate 2 devs x 8 days + QA 3 days. We'll prioritize auth + basic webhook payload (user_id, plan, usage_count).
OpsBot: Reminder: "Partner Enablement Kickoff" calendar invite created for Thu 11:00 AM PT (invites sent).
Maya (Finance): Clarify billing flow: prefer we bill and issue partner rebates unless partner is an accredited reseller. I'll draft the accounting flow for both.
Tara - VP Sales: Action items recap: 1) Partnerships + Product to scope partner portal & attribution (Ana + Liam). 2) Eng spike for SAML + webhook (Ana). 3) Legal to draft partner/reseller templates and co-brand review SLA (Priya). 4) Finance to outline billing/rebate flow and credit/clawback mechanics (Maya). 5) Partnerships to create enablement kit + certification checklist (Liam).
Liam (Partnerships): I'll post a 1-page co-sell vs referral flow and the certification checklist in #partnerships by EOD Friday.
Jamal (Head of Growth): I'll define the tracking events and share the initial dashboard spec with RevOps.
Priya (Legal): I'll circulate draft addendums and a suggested 5-business-day marketing review SLA by Tuesday.
Maya (Finance): I'll circulate the pilot billing note and proposed clawback language before the kickoff.
Morgan (CEO): Great. If anyone spots a resource conflict with these timelines, DM Tara and me. Thanks all :thumbsup:. Closing thread  add follow-ups to the kickoff invite.
